search.failed: Search failed. Check your connection and try again.
search.scriptError: English is selected — type city names in Latin (e.g. Kyiv). Switch to RU/UA for Cyrillic.
search.duplicateCity: This city is already in the list

emptyListHint: Search for a city above or allow geolocation to see the weather.

geo.loadingText: Please allow location access in the browser prompt.
geo.deniedText: Location is blocked for this site. Chrome: lock icon near URL → Site settings → Location → Allow, then try again.
geo.unavailableText: Could not determine location via browser or IP.
geo.unavailableGrantedText: Chrome already has permission, so no prompt is shown — but macOS/Chrome still cannot determine your position (POSITION_UNAVAILABLE). Enable Location Services for Google Chrome and Wi‑Fi, then retry.
geo.approximateText: Browser GPS is unavailable on this Mac/Chrome setup, so your location was estimated by IP (city-level).
geo.timeoutText: Location request timed out. Check Location Services and try again.
geo.unsupportedText: This browser does not support geolocation.
geo.insecureContext: Geolocation needs a secure origin. Open exactly http://localhost:3001 (not an IP like 192.168.x.x).
